title: Hair salons in Tel Aviv compared by services, hours and prices
intro: This guide compares nine hair salons listed on Google Maps for 'hair salon in Tel Aviv' on 25 November 2026, excluding sponsored listings and barbershops. Every fact below was taken from the salon's own website, booking page or Instagram profile where one could be fetched, otherwise from the Google Maps listing; fields the salon does not publish are left empty. It is an editorial comparison of published facts, not a review, and contains no ratings.

businesses.name: Ami Shriki
businesses.note: No website, booking page or social profile could be found or fetched; only the Google Maps listing data is recorded.

businesses.name: Gazooz (גזוז)
businesses.address: Frishman St 88 (corner of Masaryk Square), Tel Aviv
businesses.note: The salon lists only a Facebook page, which could not be fetched; a Time Out Israel listing (June 2017) describes it as a haircutting salon run by Uzi Batish at Masaryk Square for about two decades.

businesses.name: Itzik Ouaknine hair & makeup (איציק אואקיל - עיצוב שיער ואיפור)
businesses.note: Services are inferred only from the listed business name (hair design and makeup); no website or social profile could be found or fetched.

businesses.name: Omer Shimoni (עומר שמעוני מספרה)
businesses.address: Yigal Alon St 94, Alon Tower 1, Tel Aviv
businesses.prices: Women's cut incl. premium shampoo ₪390; root colour from ₪250; women's cut + ammonia-free colour from ₪550; highlights + base colour incl. cut from ₪1,200; ombré/balayage incl. cut from ₪1,200; organic straightening incl. cut from ₪1,500; curl opening incl. cut and treatments from ₪1,750; consultation (10 min) ₪250; short men's cut ₪100 (website price list; 'from' prices vary with hair length and thickness)
businesses.note: Specialises in curly and wavy hair only; appointments are booked via WhatsApp (no online booking platform); six work stations; products listed: Schwarzkopf Professional, L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Paul Mitchell, Authentic Beauty Concept, TOLSOZ, Cabello, Mon Platin.

businesses.name: Phil & Joe
businesses.note: No website, booking page or social profile could be found or fetched; only the Google Maps listing data is recorded.

businesses.name: Salon Tlv
businesses.address: Aluf Albert Mendler St 10, Tel Aviv
businesses.hours: Closes 6 pm (Google Maps, 25 Nov 2026); haircut appointments Mon–Thu 09:00–16:30, Fri 10:00–11:30 (booking page)
businesses.prices: Haircut on a treatment/colour day ₪200 with a hair artist or ₪300 with the art director; hair extensions ₪45–65 per gram depending on quality (booking page)
businesses.note: Online booking is a multi-step form on the salon's own Wix site (no third-party platform); the Instagram profile @salon.tlv gives the location only as 'Park Sarona' and the website states no street address, so the link between the site and the Mendler St 10 listing rests on that handle.

businesses.name: Studio Hafif
businesses.address: Dizengoff Center (Gate 1 or 3), Dizengoff St, Tel Aviv
businesses.note: No own website found; services are taken from the Instagram profile's story-highlight titles, which also list a second branch in Rishon LeZion (Yona Tzvi Feinstein 27).

businesses.name: Tal Beauty Look
businesses.prices: Price list is published only as images on the website's Prices page (not machine-readable)
businesses.note: Team of three listed on the website (Tal, hairdresser and owner, described as a hairdresser and makeup artist from Paris; Lihod Hatuka, barber; Anne, hairdresser); no online booking platform, contact form only.

businesses.name: The HairStudio
businesses.note: No website, booking page or social profile could be found or fetched; only the Google Maps listing data is recorded.

sources: Google Maps listings for 'hair salon in Tel Aviv', 25 November 2026
